newsitem.title: DUBAI: Three U.S. airmen die in Saudi road crash.
newsitem.headline: Three U.S. airmen die in Saudi road crash.

text.p: Three U.S. airmen died in a road accident in Saudi Arabia earlier this week, diplomatic sources in the kingdom said on Friday.
They said another three were injured in the accident on Monday near the capital Riyadh. No further details were immediately available.

The airmen are stationed in Saudi Arabia as part of the United States force participating in operation Southern Watch -- enforcing a no-fly zone over southern Iraq imposed after Baghdad's defeat in the 1991 Gulf War.

The forces were moved from Riyadh to the more secure Prince Sultan Airbase in al-Kharj, 100 km (60 miles) from the capital, after two attacks against U.S. troops in the kingdom in 1995 and 1996 killed 24 Americans and two Indians.
